events.action:
{"message": "I have identified and fixed the defects preventing the `tests/drivers/fuel_gauge/bq40z50` test suite from building and passing on `native_sim`:

1. **`tests/drivers/fuel_gauge/bq40z50/boards/native_sim.overlay`**: Added `compatible = "ti,bq40z50";` to the `bq40z50@16` I2C child node. Without the `compatible` property, `DT_HAS_TI_BQ40Z50_ENABLED` remained unset, so `CONFIG_BQ40Z50` was not enabled and the device (`__device_dts_ord_32`) was never instantiated even though `i2c_emul` referenced it as a status-okay child on `&i2c0`.
2. **`drivers/fuel_gauge/bq40z50/Kconfig`**: Fixed a typo in `config EMUL_BQ40Z50` (`depends on EMU` -> `depends on EMUL`) so that the BQ40Z50 I2C emulator is built and registered when `CONFIG_EMUL=y` is enabled.

The test suite now builds cleanly and passes all tests on `native_sim`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
